arguments.sql:
WITH eligible_players AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, height
    FROM main.Player
    WHERE height > 180
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible_players) AS eligible_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) FROM eligible_players) AS eligible_api_ids,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.Player_Attributes) AS attribute_rows,
    COUNT(*) AS joined_rows,
    COUNT(pa.heading_accuracy) AS recorded_scores,
    SUM(typeof(pa.heading_accuracy) NOT IN ('integer', 'real', 'null')) AS nonnumeric_scores,
    SUM(typeof(p.height) NOT IN ('integer', 'real')) AS nonnumeric_joined_heights
FROM eligible_players AS p
JOIN main.Player_Attributes AS pa
    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    p.player_name,
    AVG(pa.heading_accuracy) AS mean_heading_accuracy
FROM main.Player AS p
JOIN main.Player_Attributes AS pa
    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
    AND pa.heading_accuracy IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY mean_heading_accuracy DESC, p.player_api_id ASC
LIMIT 10
